hints.text: This clue's indicators are 'rings' and 'upset'. One of these is an anagram indicator, requiring us to reorder some neighbouring fodder, and the other is a containing indicator, suggesting that some fodder will go around the outside of some other fodder.

This clue's fodder is 'small', 'diamond' and 'love'. We'll need to find short substitutes for two of these words and use them along with the letters of the third to construct our answer, as guided by our indicator(s).
Our definition here is 'you've done it now!', but this definition only works once you've found the answer... (oooh so cryptic! 😂)
